title: Voiced hiragana: G and Z rows — find the sign
description: Choose the written hiragana from visible spellings; same-sound signs use explicit base-sign context.

review.provenance: Independently authored F05 voiced and semi-voiced sign exercises, not copied from legacy CSV or mocks.
review.rightsBasis: Original agent-written English prompts, feedback and glosses; kana correspondences are linguistic facts. No third-party work, recording or audio used.
